headline: DBS counts more than 430 AI use cases in its 2025 annual report
body: DBS says it runs more than 430 AI use cases. Its 2025 annual report counts over 2,000 AI models and estimates about S$1 billion in economic value from its data analytics, AI and machine-learning initiatives that year. In August, DBS gave around 1,500 relationship and credit risk managers a tool to draft a corporate credit memo, and bankers still make the approval decisions.
note: Each bank counts AI use cases in its own way. A better test is what each has put in front of its bankers and customers.

figure.label: AI use cases DBS counts in its 2025 annual report

evidence.text: DBS says it runs more than 430 AI use cases, and OCBC and UOB each put theirs at more than 300.

Its 2025 annual report counts more than 430 use cases across over 2,000 AI models and estimates that its data analytics and AI and machine-learning initiatives delivered about S$1 billion in economic value in 2025.

In August, DBS gave around 1,500 relationship and credit risk managers worldwide a tool that works through more than 70 such tasks to draft a corporate credit memo, the document that makes the case for lending to a company.
It grew out of a pilot with 150 staff, and bankers and credit risk managers still make the assessment and approval decisions.
Every bank counts in its own way, and UOB's figure includes analytics, so the totals only go so far.
A better test is what each bank has put in front of its bankers and customers this year, and what it can show for it.
